_readme: The home gallery's Drinks tab (Preston, 6 Nov 2026: 'give drinks free images, and like Aiko matcha too'; ledger 571, 7 Nov 2026: free photos of Coke and the other drinks we sell). Each group is one tile: a photo, a caption line, the group name and the catalogue drinks listed as text under it ('At MEON: ...'). `photo` is "type" for a free-library picture of the kind of drink (caption 'Photo shows the drink type'), or "exact" when the photo shows the catalogue product itself: same variant and pack, named in `shows` (caption 'Photo: <name> <size> can'). Exact photos follow Security's 571 pre-rules (requests/security/20261107-0038): a PD/CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA licence read on the source page, a label that is PD-textlogo (no illustrated packaging art), one product, no people. `credit` (CC BY / BY-SA only) is shown on the tile with a link to the licence. Every name in `drinks` (and `shows`) must match a drink in data/catalogue.json and every catalogue drink must sit in exactly one group; npm run build stops otherwise. `source` is the provenance record (Security P6): source page, author, licence and its URL, the packaging reason, the date the licence was read and the sha256 of both shipped files. Files are made by scripts/make_drink_photos.py; docs/credits.md has the same rows. Alt text: data/photo-alts.json.
